name: soft-key-door-box
task: Take the key, then open the door. After that, try to pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task unconditionally commands picking up the box ('try to pick up the box' — the preference cue scopes only the 'after that' timing, not the goal), so Existence(target_picked_up) must be hard, not soft. Also, the task 'Take the key, then open the door' commands both acquiring the key and opening the door; Response(has_door_key, door_open) plus Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) with no hard Existence(has_door_key) leaves has_door_key only required as a condition of the order, never forced to happen — the machine's FINAL_STATES is empty and nothing requires the key to be taken or the door opened. Add a hard Existence(target_picked_up); with the hard Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) alone this is a rule-only task, which misrepresents a task that commands its goals. Make the box pickup a hard goal; note the Response(has_door_key, door_open) is redundant alongside the stated Precedence if kept, but the essential fix is the missing hard goal on target_picked_up.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) with hard Existence(door_open) forces the key before the door opens; hard Existence(target_picked_up) requires the box pickup. No redundant clauses.
